headline: Indonesia Triples Free Boarding School Program for Poorest Children
meta_description: Indonesia is expanding free boarding schools for poor families, reaching 182 schools and 45,000 students this year—triple the current enrollment.
summary_short: Indonesia is expanding its free boarding school program for children from poor and extremely poor families to 182 schools, with enrollment rising to 45,000 students.
body:
Indonesia is expanding its free boarding school program for children from poor and extremely poor families, tripling enrollment to 45,000 students this year across 182 schools.

The initiative represents a significant expansion of educational access. Previously serving 15,000 students, the program now aims to reach three times that number, demonstrating a growing commitment to supporting vulnerable youth through residential education.

By providing both tuition and boarding, the program removes key barriers that keep children from impoverished households out of school. The expansion across 182 schools signals that Indonesia is scaling proven solutions to reach more families living in poverty across multiple regions.
